text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert PDR-2026-019: sudden surge in 5xx (502/504) observed at api-edge in eu-central-1 starting ~2026-03-15T16:58Z. Auto-pager to SRE oncall.
pagerduty-bot: Paging lina (SRE oncall) 1: acknowledged by lina.
lina: i'm online, grabbing dashboards. which paths are failing? any deploys around 16:50-17:00?
observability-bot: Top impacted endpoints: POST /v1/embeddings, POST /v1/generate. Error ratio eu-central-1 = 32% (last 5m). Upstream timeouts and "connection reset" seen in traces. Rolling window spike started 16:58:12Z.
noah: I see a config push to envoy-proxy pool at 16:56 (keepalive window + connection pool size tweak). That rollout hit ~60% of edge nodes. i'm checking rollout status.
devops: can we quick rollback envoy config to previous stable? If rollout caused connection churn, that'd explain upstream 502s.
lina: initiating rollback for envoy-rev-20260315-3 -> envoy-rev-20260314-7. Command: `kubectl set image deploy/ingress-proxy envoy=envoy:rev-20260314-7 -n ingress && rollout status deploy/ingress-proxy -n ingress`.
ingress-bot: rollback started. Expect proxy pods to restart across eu-central cluster. Time to converge ~90s.
noah: logs from one proxy: `envoy: upstream reset: connection failure, dial tcp 10.11.3.45:8080: i/o timeout` and backend pod logs show `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError` in backend-worker-12. Multiple backend pods OOMkilled between 16:55-16:59.
devops: autoscaler tried to spin up nodes but hit capacity in that AZ; some pods were scheduled onto older instance types with less memory and got evicted.
cs-lead: CS: customers reporting higher error rates for EU API calls; streaming sessions drop. CS team routed highest priority cases to oncall slack and posted a short status update: "We're aware of increased errors in EU region; engineers are investigating."
lina: while rollback propagates, let's shift a portion of region traffic to us-west-2 for risk reduction. Command: `redwood route modify --region eu-central-1 --shift-us-west-2 45` (gradual traffic migration).
observability-bot: Traffic shift applied. New routing rules in edge mapping. Prefilter caches cleared for /v1/* routes.
noah: enabling per-route circuit breakers to limit retries and backpressure: set `max_connections=80, max_pending_requests=30, max_requests=120` for /v1 routes on edge.
devops: concurrently, cordoning nodes with repeated OOM events and replacing with m6i.xlarge templates with +8GB memory. `kubectl cordon node-ec2-09 && k drain node-ec2-09 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
lina: monitoring: after rollback + traffic shift + node replacement, eu-central 5xx dropped from 32% -> 7% in 3 minutes. Overall prod 5xx down to 3.5%. Still not at baseline but improving.
noah: to reduce CPU pressure on proxies, temporarily disabled response compression for streaming endpoints and reduced logging verbosity on edge.
cs-lead: status page updated: minor/major? Posted update: "Degraded performance and elevated error rates affecting EU. Mitigations in progress; further updates in 30m." CS queue handling top 15 customers for targeted follow-ups.
pagerduty-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2 (customer-impacting, mitigation in progress).
observability-bot: current p95 latency eu-central dropped from 1.1s -> 280ms post-mitigation. Backend restart rate returned to baseline after new nodes came up.
lina: agreed next steps: formal RCA to determine primary cause chain (config rollout -> memory pressure -> inability to scale -> OOMs). Action items: add pre-deploy memory pressure simulation for envoy changes, increase autoscaler headroom in eu regions, and include a fast failover playbook for cross-region split.
noah: assigning postmortem to noah + lina. Draft due in 48h. I'll prepare timeline and collect logs (envoy, kube events, node metrics).
cs-lead: CS will follow up with affected customers with timeline, impact, and credits if needed. ETA comms in 24h.
oncall-bot: Incident PDR-2026-019 moved to mitigation and monitoring. Handoff: owners noah + lina for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
